entries.issue: The declared observed W_i is exactly bounded in [-1,1]^8, while a non-degenerate Gaussian vector has unbounded marginals. The joint premises have no non-degenerate model.
entries.counterexample: Any component with Gaussian variance greater than zero has positive probability outside [-1,1].
entries.repaired: Recorded a historical amendment; retained the tower theorem; replaced the exact observed-target discharge with R163 bounded Hoeffding coverage.
entries.unresolved: Whether an explicit latent Gaussian measurement model is scientifically justified, and whether a less conservative bounded interval can be certified.

entries.issue: The exact bounded fallback is extremely conservative for eight simultaneous effects.
entries.counterexample: At alpha=.05, half-width .05 requires N>=4615 even before attrition or gate failures.
entries.repaired: No practical N is claimed; DESIGN_NOT_FEASIBLE remains a legitimate output.
entries.unresolved: Empirical-Bernstein, bounded-martingale or calibrated randomization alternatives need exact planwise proofs and rare-spike stress tests.

entries.issue: Hoeffding proofs require independent participant vectors; group interaction, household coupling or one human-realized distributed system can violate this.
entries.counterexample: Duplicating one participant record N times preserves range but supplies one independent unit, not N.
entries.repaired: Independence is an explicit all-of premise and component independence is separately declared unnecessary.
entries.unresolved: Clustered or dependent designs require a different concentration theorem and effective sampling-unit definition.

entries.issue: Randomized-order mixture coverage can be misreported as an order-invariant or canonical-order bodily effect.
entries.counterexample: W=.4O+epsilon has balanced mixture mean 0 and O=+1 mean .4.
entries.repaired: Finite-design expectation explicitly includes the frozen order distribution and no invariance is inferred.
entries.unresolved: The scientifically preferred order-conditional estimand and multiplicity allocation are not frozen.

entries.issue: Clipped observations cannot identify latent effect magnitude or latent mean over an unrestricted latent class.
entries.counterexample: Latent constants 2 and 100 both produce observed clipped W=1.
entries.repaired: Coverage is scoped to the clipped observed target; latent recovery is prohibited without a measurement model.
entries.unresolved: Apparatus dynamic range and a scientifically justified saturation model remain untested.

entries.issue: Complete-case inference can fail for the all-enrollee target; support bounds require every missing would-be outcome to be mathematically well-defined.
entries.counterexample: The saved MNAR diagnostic deletes Y>-.2 and gives zero complete-case simultaneous coverage for the full-data mean; a safety abort can make Y undefined rather than missing.
entries.repaired: Added a worst-case support band for well-defined outcomes and a separate undefined-target stop condition.
entries.unresolved: A treatment-policy estimand, safety intercurrent-event rule and scientifically credible sensitivity model are not selected.

entries.issue: Sign-flip, bootstrap and max-t labels can be mistaken for exact universal coverage.
entries.counterexample: Bounded skew lacks sign invariance; bootstrap calibration is not a finite-sample theorem over all bounded laws.
entries.repaired: Candidate disposition states the required symmetry, sharp-null or calibration premises and accepts none without a new proof.
entries.unresolved: A less conservative frozen family has not been certified.

entries.issue: A statistically covered population mean can be mistaken for a within-experience relation, complete organization, familiar ownership or a unique subject.
entries.counterexample: The same bounded population contrast can arise from different unmeasured token organizations and reports.
entries.repaired: The note keeps actual token, installed measurement, statistical target, physical-role decision and experience interpretation distinct.
entries.unresolved: Selected-target semantics and sufficiency/reflection evidence remain absent.

entries.issue: The general proofs are manual; simulations are deterministic diagnostics, not global verification; no R161 apparatus data exist.
entries.counterexample: A proof transcription error or dependent installed sampling process could invalidate an implementation despite passing code checks.
entries.repaired: Exact enumeration, theorem assumptions, source scope and simulation status are explicit and reproducible.
entries.unresolved: Independent statistical review, proof-assistant formalization, and ethics-approved feasibility evidence remain open.
